  DIET_LastWkFeelFullEnergy +

  (6 - DIET_LastWkFeelLonely) +

notes: The ten KIDSCREEN-10 items, all asked on the standard 1-5 intensity scale, summed with the two negatively worded items (sad, lonely) reverse-scored so that higher means better quality of life. Observed range 15-50, 74 participants missing (any item missing gives NA). ISCOLE also supplies its own KidScreen variable, but that is the Rasch T-value transformation (range 20.6-83.8), which is outside the dataschema's 10-50 raw-sum range; the raw sum here is a strictly monotone function of it (Spearman rho = 1.00 across all 7298 scored participants), so nothing is lost by using the raw sum the dataschema asks for
